items.en: Report: Palestinian woman loses fetus due to Israeli army ambulance delay in West Bank.

items.en: Saudi Crown Prince and UK leader reviewed ties amid Houthi Red Sea attacks.

items.en: Israeli forces launch new incursions into southern Syria.
